prompt: An action’s next release renames an input — a breaking change. What does the maintainer owe consumers?
explanation: Renaming an input breaks every workflow that passes the old name, so it lands as a new major tag (`v3`) while `v2` keeps serving the old contract. Force-moving an existing tag silently breaks the very consumers who pinned for stability.

options.text: A patch release; consumers will adapt
A new major version tag, with the old major kept working for existing users
Nothing — inputs are not part of the contract
A force-push of the existing tag to the new code
